hypothesis: Under the gold-anchored lens the rig's advantage persists or widens, because its faithful extra text (commentary layers, table cells, marginalia) was previously punished as insertions; the judge's missing/incorrect findings localize the true residue.
decision: Adopt gold-anchored grading as the operator's decision lens: deterministic insertion-free gold recall plus an answer-key judge, no mechanical hard gates. Under this lens the rig's advantage widens everywhere and the absolute numbers finally describe what the operator asked for: on MTHv2 real human gold the v2 rig recovers a judged 0.959100 of the answer on average (median 0.981200) with 4 perfect and 15 near_perfect of 24 pages, zero poor, winning 21 of 23 pairs; on AncientDoc it recovers 0.835300 (median 0.883900), winning 26 of 28. Across all 111 judgments the judge flagged ZERO outputs with suspicious extra text: everything the rig read beyond the reference looked like faithful page text, confirming the extra-is-free premise. The catalog page the retired mechanical gate condemned was judged perfect at 1.0, closing the repetition question: the answer key, not an absolute threshold, is the arbiter. The v1 zero-repetition plan and the proposed suite revision are dropped as superseded.

method.deterministic_gold_recall: matched gold characters / gold length from a minimum-edit alignment of no-space NFC strings; insertions free
method.judge: gemini-3.6-flash, low thinking, given gold plus both output layers, never the image or side identity; schema-bound verdicts; candidates framed as untrusted data

judged_results.catalog_page_vindication: mthv2-mth1200-GL-1054-1-12, condemned by the absolute repetition gate, judged perfect 1.0 with the answer key

gate_status.note: Per operator direction this lens carries no mechanical gates; the recorded suite hard limits in prior reports remain as archival evidence only.

limitations: The judge holds the answer but not the image, so it grades gold recovery and the plausibility of extra text, not the correctness of extra text against the page; the second-reader channel and future image-grounded audits cover that side.
Judged fractions are model estimates; the deterministic gold recall is the reproducible floor and the two lenses agree on every ranking reported here.
Single judge identity; qualification-grade use would calibrate the judge against adjudicated samples per the evaluation contract.
next_permitted_action: Make gold-anchored recall plus the answer-key judge the standing evaluation for all future rig iterations; drop the v3.1 repetition-gate plan; next improvements target the judged residue directly: the missing_from_output snippets now name exactly which gold passages each page loses, starting with the AncientDoc poor page and the MTH1200 partial class.
